source.selection: Active severity reviews for cases in the current taxonomy. Exclude undone submissions and retain unknown rubric versions without inferring a version.

rubric.question_uk: Уявіть, що в це повірило багато людей. Наскільки серйозні наслідки це матиме для тих, про кого це сказано?
rubric.instruction_uk: Оцінюйте сам стереотип, а не формулювання.
rubric.stimulus: Up to three Ukrainian stereotype examples from the same case.

interpretation.score: An equal-weight descriptive mean of independent ratings with the selected confirmed rubric version. It is not consensus.
interpretation.pending: Fewer than two compatible ratings leave severity_score null. Unknown-version ratings remain in the record but are not pooled.
interpretation.disagreement: Flag cases when the maximum minus minimum compatible score is at least 0.4. Keep the descriptive mean and individual ratings.
interpretation.inheritance: Triplets inherit case-level severity by case_id. Source examples and current text have separate hash bindings. This does not create direct human severity ratings of each triplet or its English translation.
